items/anstruth-harp-176.name: Anstruth Harp
items/anstruth-harp-176.effectSummary: This masterwork harp grants +2 circumstance on Perform (string instruments) and +6 competence on bardic music checks for countersong, fascinate, and suggestion. A character with at least 12 ranks in Perform (string instruments) can use control water, mass cure light wounds, and mind fog once per day each. A creature holding it without at least 12 ranks in Perform (string instruments) gains one negative level for as long as it is held; this never causes actual level loss and cannot be removed while the harp is held.

items/apparatus-kwalish-119.name: Apparatus of Kwalish
items/apparatus-kwalish-119.effectSummary: The apparatus is a sealed iron vehicle for two Medium creatures with AC 20, hardness 15, 200 hp, land speed 20 feet, swim speed 20 feet, and a maximum safe depth of 900 feet. Its secret hatch requires Search DC 20 to find from outside. Ten internal levers respectively extend/retract legs and tail; open/close the forward porthole; open/close the side portholes; extend/retract pincers and feelers; make the pincers attack; move forward/backward; turn left/right; activate/deactivate continual-flame eyes; rise/sink in water; and open/close the hatch. Operating a lever is a full-round action and each lever can be used at most once per round. The apparatus makes two pincer attacks at +12 melee for 2d8 damage each; with two operators it can move and attack in the same round. It contains enough air for two creatures for 1d4+1 hours, or twice that long for one creature.

items/axe-of-ancestral-virtue-627.name: Axe of Ancestral Virtue [Relic]
items/axe-of-ancestral-virtue-627.effectSummary: For a lawful-good, lawful-neutral, or neutral-good wielder, this functions as a +1 keen adamantine dwarven waraxe. With the relic connection to Moradin, it becomes intelligent and sentient (LN; Int 10, Wis 17, Cha 17; speech, telepathy, darkvision 120 ft., hearing; Ego 17) and can use bless, cure moderate wounds on its wielder, and faerie fire three times per day each. The relic connection requires worship of Moradin plus either a sacrificed 5th-level divine spell slot or True Believer with at least 9 HD. With a sacrificed 7th-level divine slot or True Believer with at least 13 HD, it can also haste its wielder three times per day. Its personality urges attacks against traditional dwarf enemies such as goblinoids and giants and strongly favors traditional dwarf culture.

items/beast-694.name: Beast
items/beast-694.effectSummary: This specific psicrown follows the standard psicrown power-trigger rules and contains 450 power points. It can spend those points only on these powers: claw of energy, duodimensional claw, prevenom, psionic lion's charge, and truevenom. The wearer may augment those powers with the crown's own points subject to the standard psicrown limit, cannot add personal power points, and may use their own manifester level if it is higher than the crown's.

items/bracelet-of-thrust-744.name: Bracelet of Thrust
items/bracelet-of-thrust-744.effectSummary: Activating the polished brass bracelet grants the effects of the thrust power. It can be combined with a bracelet of bolts into one item; the combined bracelet can be activated as a single item, creating ammunition as the bracelet of bolts with the thrust power applied to that ammunition.

items/caduceus-447.name: Caduceus
items/caduceus-447.effectSummary: This intelligent neutral-good staff functions as a staff of healing and has Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 10, speech, 120-foot vision and hearing, and Ego 6. It understands Celestial, Common, and Infernal and can use ease pain once per day and vision of heaven three times per day. Its personality abhors bloodshed and may refuse to heal wounds it judges justified or deserved.

items/cloud-giant-harp.name: Cloud Giant Harp
items/cloud-giant-harp.effectSummary: The harp can be played as a standard action, with only one activation attempt allowed per day. A DC 15 Perform (string instruments) check puts up to 10 HD of humanoids within 30 feet to sleep as deep slumber, Will DC 14 negates. A DC 20 check instead can affect up to 20 HD of giants; if the check misses DC 20 but still reaches DC 15, the 10-HD effect still works. Sentient variants retain these mechanics but may complain about non-giant masters while still generally obeying them.
